steps.en: The option 'Others' is available for the relationship
steps.id: Opsi 'Others' tersedia untuk hubungan dengan owner

steps.en: A free-text box appears when 'Others' is selected
steps.id: Kotak teks bebas muncul saat 'Others' dipilih

steps.en: The description is required and must be 2 to 50 characters
steps.id: Deskripsi wajib diisi dan harus 2 sampai 50 karakter

steps.en: The description is checked again and saved with the submission
steps.id: Deskripsi dicek ulang dan disimpan bersama submission
